title: A Trap fused into a Unit never fires from its unit zone, whatever fused it
notes: R2226000, R1020: a Trap's or Field Trap's text fused into a card that stands in a unit zone and is no trap never fires from there, whatever fused it (饕餮, an Equip, a Starship Piece's copy in its Dormant Starship). Queued as a unit's trigger it answered every event its condition admits since R2271000 (v0.5.2b), so 饕餮 holding Wormhole stole the opponent's Spells from its unit zone; before R2271000 read that condition, the same 饕餮 countered and recast its own controller's Spell for ever, which the daily fuzz waves of #2226 found. The classifier shows Clip-Farming Lawyer (meditative-027), 赌石 Addict (meditative-039), Tnack Trav (stinkyscape-020), Spacerace Stimulus (stinkyscape-131), the Dormant Starship (stinkyscape-t-dormant-starship), the token a Starship Piece's fused text stands in, and The Rock (traininggrounds-054) playing differently, and a divergence no card explains: a Trap fused into a card no deck held.

player.title: A Trap fused into a Unit stays quiet
fixes: A Trap fused into a Unit no longer springs from it, whatever fused it: Wormhole eaten by 饕餮 no longer steals your opponent's Spells.
